notes: DRAFT SKELETON, never run; the menu part reuses recorded checkpoints, everything after ARCADE QUEST is TODO. Main menu home tab: STORY (cursor start, story_selected) > down 1 = ARCADE QUEST. First visit: avatar creation (keep a preset avatar, confirm; never type into a text field or open a store item), then the 3D arcade hub (third-person avatar, W/A/S/D walk, J talk/confirm, K back), NPC dialogue, tutorial overlays that ask for exact inputs, and the chapter's matches against NPC avatars (any fighter, so the KAZUYA-plate in_match does not apply). Clearing Chapter 1 unlocks Super Ghost Battle. Estimated 30-60 min. Progress is in global1.sav (local only). The hub walk to each objective is the part a blind recipe cannot do: it needs recorded waypoints (walk key + hold time + turn) from a discovery run.
